title: Live multi-window accepted-state recomposition of Stage-0 forcing and restricted Feddes uptake

authorities.root_uptake: F-CI31 restricted Reference-ET to Feddes execution

recomposition_contract: At the start of each coupling window, materialize PPA-WU03 forcing for that window from the frozen phase input.
Evaluate F-CI31 root uptake exactly once from the current accepted committed SWAP state and that window's potential transpiration.
Write the resulting root_extraction_sink and pure-flux top boundary into one immutable physical forcing object for the complete coupling window.
All predictor and same-origin corrector trials in that window reuse the same immutable forcing and root sink.
No root-stress or atmospheric forcing reevaluation occurs inside a coupled fixed-point iteration.
After exact-once acceptance/commit, the next window recomputes forcing and root uptake from the newly committed state.
pass_gates: window phase sequence is exactly drought,drought,recovery,recovery
potential transpiration sequence is exactly [0.4,0.4,0.3,0.3] cm/day within floating-point tolerance
top-flux sequence is exactly [0,0,-0.5,-0.5] cm/day while the admitted pure-flux regime remains valid
each window root sink is finite, nonnegative, and actual uptake is <= potential transpiration
same-origin corrector calls do not change the window root sink or top flux
next-window root sink is explicitly recomputed after committed revision advances
if committed root-zone hydraulic state changes, recomposition is allowed to change actual root uptake; no minimum change is required
all four predictors retain complete prescribed-root tangent coverage and temporal indicators <=1
all four live coupled fixed points converge within six iterations under unchanged interface/flux criteria
hard mass, exact-once publication, revision/time/ledger monotonicity and O0/O2 behavior pass
revision sequence [1,2,3,4], committed time [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4] day, ledger count [1,2,3,4]
forbidden_after_execution: change Feddes parameters or qualification root distribution
relax H_app, temporal, interface, flux, solver, retry or mass criteria
reevaluate root uptake inside the same coupling window
reduce precipitation to keep recovery in flux regime
reinitialize SWAP or MODFLOW between windows
nonclaims: qualification root geometry is not final Stage-0 0.60 m discretization
soil hydraulic sets are not yet frozen
downstream_if_pass: Freeze Stage-0 grid/root geometry, three defensible soil hydraulic parameter sets and storage diagnostics, then execute only the preregistered Stage-0 falsification pilot.

amendments.trigger: First DYN02 run 35460379501 failed during first-window recomposition because F-CI31 process hydraulic view rejected the temporal-history committed carrier.
amendments.disposition: Rebase unchanged DYN02 experiment onto canonical DYN02-VIEW01 authority.
